meta.what: Instructions the interpreter executes for one serialise, deserialise and re-serialise round trip of each payload family of the generated Python, under cachegrind, in the pure runtime of each specialisation.
meta.how: The interpreter runs each family at N and at 2N iterations; the difference over N is one iteration, with start-up, imports and teardown cancelled.
meta.keys: counts[<platform.machine()>], recording the interpreter build it was taken with as sys.version states it. Off CI, an architecture or an interpreter build with no baseline skips and prints the entry to paste; on CI it fails.
meta.rebaseline_when: A change to the generated Python or its runtime that moves a count, or a new interpreter in the image. Run python_runtime_instructions.py with --update in the change that causes it.
